🌟 scroll-world | JavaScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: Creating unique, interactive, and visually engaging brand landing pages that simulate a 'fly-through' experience.
✨ Key Features: • Generates immersive, scroll-scrubbed 3D world landing pages • AI-driven scene and camera flight generation • Seamless camera transitions between scenes (no cuts) • Framework-agnostic vanilla-JS scrub engine • Optional mobile-optimized 9:16 portrait version
📖 Summary: This repository provides a skill for AI agents like Claude Code and Codex to generate immersive, scroll-scrubbed 3D world landing pages for brands. It uses AI to create scenes and camera flights, allowing users to experience a continuous, fly-through narrative as they scroll.
